messages:
Alex Chen: Quick question — for the routing policy editor in Console: should tier rules (free/pro/enterprise) inherit from a global policy or be explicit per tier? Need to decide UX + API shape.

Mira Patel: my vote: inherit from global with itemized overrides. Less noisy for common defaults. :+1:

Samir Khan: Agree inheriting makes sense, but we need clear visibility for fallback variants by region. e.g., enterprise in eu-west should show which model variant will be used when capacity constrained.

Jess Ortega: +1. Also we should avoid too-deep nesting. Proposal: Global -> Tier overrides -> Region overrides -> Tenant exceptions. Collapse rows in UI and show effective policy summary.

Lee Wang: UX question — when there is a quota hit do we show the reason inline? e.g., "quota exhausted for pro plan -> routed to cheaper-variant". That's helpful for support.

Alex Chen: Good call. For enforcement we have two layers: soft quota (warn & fallback) and hard quota (reject). Should be configurable per tier. Do we want API flags: allow_soft_fallback=true/false, fallback_order=[variants]?

Samir Khan: API shape I'd prefer: {
  "inherit": true,
  "soft_quota_policy": "allow_fallback",
  "fallback_sequence": ["redwood-base-q8", "redwood-quant-safe"]
}

We can keep it simple JSON-wise.

Mira Patel: From product POV, default pro=soft fallback enabled, free=always fallback to smallest model, enterprise=soft fallback disabled by default (but configurable).

Jess Ortega: Telemetry needed: emit events on decision path e.g., `route_decision:{tier,region,selected_variant,reason}` and counters for fallback_rate per tier+region. This must surface on Dashboard.

ops-bot: deploy-check: routing-service config lint passed for branch feature/routing-editor (ci-452). :white_check_mark:

Lee Wang: For Console rollout UX: expose an "effective policy" preview per tenant and a "what-if" simulator where you can toggle soft quota on/off and see predicted fallback percentages (based on recent telemetry).

Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Samir to draft API proto + example JSON by EOD. 2) Jess to add telemetry event names + dashboard wireframe. 3) Mira to write default per-tier semantics. 4) Lee to mock Console preview. I'll collect and we iterate tomorrow. Thanks!
